subject: art-design
title: Colour & Tone: Harmonies
welcome_lead: Complementary, analogous and warm/cool — colours that work together.
meta_desc: KS3 colour: complementary pairs, analogous schemes, warm and cool.
final_note: Colour relationships make your composition feel intentional.

concepts.def: Colours next to each other on the wheel.

walkthroughs.body_html: Across the wheel: red-green, blue-orange, yellow-purple. Place complementaries side by side and both look brighter. Mix them and they dull each other.
Pick 3 colours sitting next to each other — like yellow, yellow-green, green. These analogous schemes feel calm and unified.
Warm colours feel close, energetic, sunny. Cool colours feel distant, calm, shadowy. Painters use this to push parts of an image forward or back.
